list.name: group
list.label: 调用与 Token 分组
list.query: 模型 : model,用户 : user_id,应用 : app_id,全部 : job

panels.title: 抓取状态
panels.description: 1 表示配置在 xy-backend 下的实例均在线；0 表示至少一个实例无法抓取。

panels.title: 累计模型调用
panels.description: 当前可见实例自启动以来发起的 SDK 调用，每次工具续写或质检调用单独计数。

panels.title: 累计失败调用
panels.description: 只计模型 SDK 报告的错误；启动数与完成数之差不等于失败数。

panels.title: 累计已报告 Token
panels.description: 读取 total，不重复加上 input 和 output；没有用量报告时无数据。

panels.title: 模型调用趋势
panels.description: 按选定维度统计两端抓取之间的实际新增调用，包含首次出现的用户或应用。任一实例缺少可靠基线时，滚动趋势留空。app_id=none 表示创建前的路由。

targets.expr: (sum by (${group:raw}) ((xy_ai_calls_total{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_calls_total{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_calls_total{job="xy-backend"})) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

panels.title: 输入、输出与总 Token
panels.description: 按所选模型、用户或应用分别显示输入、输出和总用量；选“全部”可查看平台合计。total 已含输入和输出，缺少可靠基线时留空。

targets.expr: (sum by (${group:raw}, type) ((xy_ai_tokens_total{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_tokens_total{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_tokens_total{job="xy-backend"})) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

panels.title: 模型平均响应时间
panels.description: 两端抓取之间新增的耗时之和除以新增的已结束调用数，单位为秒。缺少可靠基线时留空。

targets.expr: (sum by (model) ((xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_sum{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_sum{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_sum{job="xy-backend"}) / (sum by (model) ((xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_count{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_count{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_call_duration_seconds_count{job="xy-backend"}) > 0)) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

panels.title: 模型响应时间分位数
panels.description: 先合并同一模型各实例在两端抓取之间的新增桶计数，再估算 P50、P90、P95 和 P99。缺少可靠基线时留空。

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) ((xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"}))) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

(histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, model) ((xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"}))) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) ((xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"}))) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, model) ((xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_model_latency_seconds_bucket{job="xy-backend"}))) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

panels.title: 应用调用次数 Top 10
panels.description: 当前可见实例的累计值；各实例重启后计数从零开始。

panels.title: 用户调用次数 Top 10
panels.description: 当前可见实例的累计值；各实例重启后计数从零开始。

panels.title: 应用 Token 消耗 Top 10
panels.description: 当前可见实例的累计值；各实例重启后计数从零开始。

panels.title: 用户 Token 消耗 Top 10
panels.description: 当前可见实例的累计值；各实例重启后计数从零开始。

panels.title: 按错误类型统计失败
panels.description: 按模型和异常类型统计两端抓取之间的新增失败，首次出现的异常也计入。缺少可靠基线时留空。

targets.expr: (sum by (model, reason) ((xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"} - xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"})) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))

panels.title: 各模型失败率
panels.description: 两端抓取之间的新增失败除以新增的已结束调用。仅有成功显示 0%；无已结束调用、实例重启或缺少可靠基线时留空。

targets.expr: ((sum by (model) ((xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"} - xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend",status="error"}) or on(model) (0 * sum by (model) ((xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"}))) / (sum by (model) ((xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"} - xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) or xy_ai_outcomes_total{job="xy-backend"}) > 0)) unless on() ((present_over_time(up{job="xy-backend"}[${window:raw}]) or up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) unless on(job,instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} == process_start_time_seconds{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xy-backend"} offset ${window:raw} == 1)))
